Meaning: Upper bound for existing Blueprint exposure, not endorsement of every legacy entry or permission to remove serialized APIs. New entries require audience, authority, result and migration review.

ReviewNotes.Scope: Reconcile seven already submitted entries absent from the October 3 baseline. Rack changes add no Blueprint inventory entry points. Existing serialized contracts retained.

ExistingEntries.Plugins/Gameplay/AtlasInventorySystem/So: Existing authority-only exact-entry payment and payout transaction; mutation receipt and rejection preserve both endpoints.
Existing authority-only retry of confirmed payout; retained inventory is the pending-delivery state.
Existing read-only query of the exchange container, needed by interaction availability.
Existing logical-content selection for new grants only; bool, definition and error distinguish removal and failure. Transfers/restores retain concrete identity.
Existing new-job selection; concrete accepted jobs are not re-resolved.
Existing effective recipe picker query; no inventory mutation.
Existing read-only stable-entry transfer preview; uses the same owner policy as execution.

ReviewedAdditions.Authority: Local presentation only; component must belong to this collectable. Does not grant items or alter authoritative inventory.
ReviewedAdditions.Result: True only when a mesh is available. Pending/empty state clears mesh, material overrides and overlay instead of showing a placeholder. Referenced visual assets may load synchronously.
ReviewedAdditions.Migration: Preserves existing serialized UpdateMesh callers; no reflected rename.
ReviewedAdditions.Validation: AtlasInventoryWorldDropLifecycleTests.cpp covers pending/late/replaced presentation and rejecting a foreign component.
